    • addMember

      public PbcsMember addMember(String dimensionName, String memberName, String parentName)
      CREST doc: Adds a new member to the application outline in the specified dimension and plan type and under the specified parent member. Prerequisite: The parent member must be enabled for dynamic children and a cube refresh must have happened after the parent was enabled.
      Specified by:
      addMember in interface PbcsApplication

    • getMember

      public PbcsMember getMember(String dimensionName, String memberName)
      Description copied from interface: PbcsApplication
      Get information about a member. This is considered the canonical way to get a member from the PBCS/EPM Cloud member info API since it can make a straight call to the proper end point. The REST API endpoint has the dimension name in it, which necessitates knowing the dimension name ahead of time (unfortunately).

      You will almost always be better served using methods on the PbcsPlanType, such as the equivalent method PbcsPlanType.getMember(String, String).

      Specified by:
      getMember in interface PbcsApplication
      Parameters:
      dimensionName - the name of the dimension that the member is in
      memberName - the member name to look up
      Returns:
      the member
